run_eigenvalue_correction_tests: run the parametrized unittest test suite to verify DistributedShampoo eigenvalue correction against AdaGrad, Adam, AdamW, and RMSprop
test_adagrad_eigenvalue_correction: test DistributedShampoo with betas (0.0, 1.0) matches AdaGrad optimizer behavior using eigenvalue correction preconditioner
test_adam_eigenvalue_correction: test DistributedShampoo with betas (0.9, 0.999) matches Adam optimizer behavior using eigenvalue correction preconditioner
test_adamw_eigenvalue_correction: test DistributedShampoo with decoupled weight decay matches AdamW optimizer behavior using eigenvalue correction preconditioner
test_rmsprop_eigenvalue_correction: test DistributedShampoo with betas (0.0, 0.99) and no bias correction matches RMSprop optimizer behavior
